# Keep the cockpit current when navigation happens with the popup closed

## What & Why
The extension now persists page history and reconnect state safely, but the cockpit still receives that status through a manual session export/import. A later improvement could make a closed-popup navigation easier to review without requiring a new manual handoff.

## Done looks like
- Navigation and origin changes recorded while the popup is closed remain available for cockpit review
- The cockpit can refresh or re-import the latest session without touching profile or application data
- Emergency-stop state remains latched during the refresh path

- browser/application-assist/content.js
- browser/application-assist/popup.js
